functions.name: SetTreeView
functions.docs: Sets the TreeView to be filtered.

functions.name: SetFilter
functions.docs: Sets the filter which will be used to filter the items in the TreeView.

functions.name: SetRootItems
functions.signature: SetRootItems(Target, In Root Items, In Tree Root Items)

functions.name: SetGetChildrenDelegate
functions.docs:
Sets the delegate which should be used for traversing the children of the nodes in
the tree.

functions.name: GetIsEnabled
functions.docs: Gets whether or not filtering is enabled for the TreeView.

functions.name: SetIsEnabled
functions.docs:
Sets whether or not filtering the tree is enabled. Calling this DOES NOT refresh the tree,
this must be done by calling RefreshAndFilterTree.

functions.name: RemoveCachedItem
functions.docs: Removes any cached references to an item.

functions.name: RefreshAndFilterTree
functions.docs:
Refreshes the associated TreeView, filtering items if the filter is enabled. When filtering,
the expanded state of the items is saved, and when the filter is cleared the pre-filter expand
state is restored.

functions.name: OnGetFilteredChildren
functions.docs:
Gets the children for a node in the tree which pass the filter if filtering is enabled, or
gets all children if the filter is not enabled. In order for filtering to work correctly this
function must be used for the TreeView's OnGetChildren delegate.
